title: VRM Style Profile
description: A machine-readable, lintable definition of a visual style for VRM avatars. A profile is a list of rules; each rule names a metric produced by scripts/style_lint.py `measure`, an envelope the metric must fall in, a severity, and the provenance of the envelope. Rules are data: adding a rule never requires changing the linter unless it needs a new metric.

extends.description: id of a base profile whose rules are inherited (informational in v0; the linter does not resolve inheritance yet).

metric_definitions.description: Operational definitions of every metric this profile references, keyed by metric path. Metrics must be computable from spec-mandated data (glTF geometry/skins, VRMC_vrm humanoid/expressions/lookAt/meta, VRMC_springBone, VRMC_materials_mtoon) plus the material-role assignment.

material_roles.description: Role vocabulary used by material-scoped rules. Role assignment is an input to the linter (name heuristic by default; overridable per material), never something the profile depends on being encoded in the file.

corpus.description: The assets the envelopes were derived from.

effective_n.description: Distinct bodies after collapsing re-exports of the same VRoid body.

reference_tiers.description: External budget tables cited for context (e.g. VRChat performance ranks). Informational; not evaluated.

class.description: aesthetic: what makes the avatar read as this style. interop: round-trip requirements ecosystems reject files without. budget: performance envelope. fingerprint: a constant every corpus asset shares because one tool wrote it — never `must`; tells you what tool produced the file, not whether it is in style.

roles.description: material scope only: roles or role groups the rule applies to; empty means every material.

filter.description: material scope only: equality conditions on material entry keys that must hold for a material to be in scope (e.g. {"alphaMode": "MASK"}).

metric.description: asset scope: dotted path into the measurement (asset.*, proportions.*, springs.*, expressions.*, lookat.*, meta.*). material scope: key of a material entry.

provenance.description: Where the envelope came from. A metric unavailable on an asset counts as a failure, so every rule should say what data it needs.

n.description: Number of observations (assets or materials) behind the envelope.

conforming.description: k/n observations inside the envelope, written by `envelopes --write`.
